# ui::TextLayoutParagraph

Header: `winui/render/TextLayout.hpp`.

Runs that flow together, with a margin around the block. Paragraphs are joined by one `\n` in [TextLayout::text()](text-layout.md#text).

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `runs` | `std::vector<TextLayoutRun>` |  | The runs, in reading order. An empty list still takes one line of [TextLayoutOptions::base_style](text-layout-options.md) height. |
| `margin` | `Thickness` |  | Space around the paragraph in DIPs; vertical margins are not collapsed between paragraphs. |
